purpose: Observe the first two training epochs of the existing Wine protocol, not tune it
metrics: actual cloned parameter delta L2 norm
delta/parameter ratio, null when denominator is zero
actual delta versus negative learning rate times momentum buffer
grouping: each named parameter, preserving separate weights and zero-initialized biases
observations: No layer ranking, convergence or accuracy acceptance thresholds
comparison: diagnostics-enabled versus diagnostics-disabled runs with identical minimal trajectory hashing; exact legacy fit_candidate final tensors and history
noninterference: exact equality within this process/environment; no cross-platform claim
budget: 6 configurations x 14 updates x 3 passes (observed, diagnostics-disabled audit, legacy reference) = 252 updates and 3852 sample visits; prefix, not full benchmark
